topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Well, now, isn’t this a curious turn of the season? My neighbor, Tim, was tellin’ me about his invention, a device to keep the mice from nibblin’ at the grains. He’s been workin’ on it all through the wet months, and I can see the pride in his eyes. It turns out, though, someone else has already thought of it and got the papers and such. Yet, Tim’s version is better crafted, more sturdy and clever. He says he might still sell it, even if he can’t call it his own. A good tinkerer like him, with hands as skilled as his, will find a way to make do. The world’s full of folks needin’ fine tools, after all, and his mice guard will surely have its day in the sun.
